items.note: a one-line flow schematic pasted into the running text: two outlined black arrows labelled INFLOW and OUTFLOW converge on a central light-blue gradient rectangle reading "WATER SUPPLY", with no axes, no legend, no numbers and no caption; the arrowheads point at the box from both sides, and the whole thing is a low resolution raster whose soft blue gradient and hairline border do not match the document's vector line weights or its serif face, so it reads as clip art rather than a figure. It is the paper's picture of the accounting identity the two following equations then state.

a top-down block-and-arrow diagram of the water stock: a green-bordered box "Renewable Resources" and a red-bordered box "Nonrenewable Resources" both arrow down into a blue horizontal bar "Water_available", which arrows down into three orange gradient circles lettered I, A and R; no axes, no legend, no numbers, no caption; the red box carries a heavy black drop-shadow the green one lacks, and the letters I, A, R are never expanded in the art, so the three withdrawals it introduces can only be read from the body text.

the same diagram one step further on, now with three source boxes - red "Nonrenewable Resources", green "Renewable Resources" and green "Artificial Replenishment" - feeding the blue "Water_available" bar, which exchanges paired curved bidirectional arrows with the orange circles I, A and R, each of which arrows down into a red trapezoid labelled "Waste"; no axes, no legend, no numbers and no printed caption though the page prints the sub-heading "Artificial Replenishment" directly above it; none of the flows is quantified here, which is what the identical diagram on p12 then supplies with boxed values.

a three-series smoothed line chart of water scarcity in the Nile valley with no axis titles at all: x is years with ticks 1960 to 2010 at five-year steps and the lines running on past 2010 to the frame edge, y is ticked 0 to 100M in steps of 10M with no unit and no explanation of the M; the three series are named only by colour-matched floating labels set outside the plot on the right - Ethiopia red at the top, Egypt blue in the middle, Sudan yellow low against its line - so the "legend" is three loose words rather than a key; no title in the art and no data labels; the rounded curves, pale gridlines and sans-serif colour labels are a pasted infographic style that clashes with the document elsewhere.

note: 29 PDF sheets whose running header prints "Team 53494 ICM 2016" and the printed folio alone, so printed page = PDF page - 1 and the document is 28 printed pages; PDF 1 is the official summary sheet with the "For office use only / Team Control Number" stub block, which the layout pass did not measure and which needs no exclusion. 20 measured regions on 13 pages - 3, 4, 5, 10, 12, 15, 16, 17, 18, 22, 23, 24 and 27 - giving 8 figure rows and 7 table rows after 5 exclusions (two page-fold continuations, p17r1 and p18r1, and three green cell bands that are the rest of the p27 rotated table), with nothing unaccounted. Numbering is minimal: the whole document prints three numbers, all in the appendix and all as "Figure 4.N –" with an en dash, so the appendix figures are numbered to chapter 4 while physically following the conclusion; two more wide tables - "MODEL 1 - Climate Change not factored in" on p25 and "MODEL 2 - Climate Change included" on p26 - are typeset without any vector rule, so the layout pass produced no region for them and they sit outside the row ledger by construction (they are named in this note rather than silently dropped), which makes this the first paper in the range whose table count is not recoverable from the region list alone. Caption placement is inverted: the three printed captions are the only captions in the batch printed ABOVE their artwork, verified against block coordinates. The exhibits divide cleanly by section: section 2 carries three hand-drawn flow schematics of the water stock (inflow/outflow into a WATER SUPPLY box, the renewable/nonrenewable block diagram, and the same diagram with Artificial Replenishment and a Waste sink), section 4 carries a three-series Nile chart with no axis titles and a colour-word legend and then the quantified version of the schematic with twelve boxed values and a Key box whose first footnote is overprinted into an illegible smear, and the appendix carries the three captioned regression charts plus three rotated forecast tables. The body's six data tables are one forecast run presented five ways - the same yearly predictions in different column orders and column sets - and none of them says which model run it belongs to; two of them break across a page fold with no header repeated, and the p15 head calls a column Sustainable Withdrawal where the next table calls the same column Sustainable Resources. Citation is minimal but not absent: each appendix figure is named once in the body as "Appendix Figure 4.N", and the one pointer in section 4 is deictic - "ing chart shows data for 2005 overlaid onto our flow model" on p11, whose referent is the p12 diagram rather than the p10 chart it follows; everything else, including every table, is introduced only as "the following" or "the above".
rules: 题注位置照实测记：全篇只有三个印刷题注，三处都印在图的上方（position=above），与这批论文其余各篇的图题在下相反；p22 两条、p23 一条，是用块坐标逐个核对过的，不是从文字层行序推的。[caption.position]
编号与章节号脱钩：附录里的三张图印作 "Figure 4.1 –"、"Figure 4.2 –"、"Figure 4.3 –"，用的是第 4 章的编号，却印在结论页之后、Appendices 之下，正文也按 "Appendix Figure 4.1" 这样的写法引用，故 numbering 按印刷值记，place 仍取附录标题。[caption.numbering]
附录标题是无编号标题：p22 印 "Appendices" 而没有节号，标题抽取器漏检，section_path 因此记作加 "未编号标题" 前缀的 Appendices，section_kind=appendix。[place.section_path]
一个被检出的宽表按它实际的颜色分区排除：p27 的 19 列旋转表只有绿色填充的四列产生矢量几何，检测器因此给出 p27r1-r4 四条窄带；四条带是一张表，记一次 rows=21、cols=19，其余三条以 split-across-pages 排除并在备注写明是同页切分而不是跨页。[table.rows]
跨页续排的表只计一次并记 continued：p16r2 的五列分区表接到 p17r1、p17r3 的六列表接到 p18r1，两处续页都没有重复表头，故各记 continued=true、rows 覆盖两半，续页行作 split-across-pages 排除。[table.continued]
线型按目视：正文与附录的六张数据表都只画横线（表头下一条、行间逐条），既不封外框也没有列分隔线，全部记 booktabs；p3、p5、p12 三张流程图不是表格，不在线型统计内。[table.rule_style]
单位不在表头：p15 的单位写在表上方句子里 "all values in km3/yr"，p17r2 的单位写在表内标题带 "Agricultural Consumption (km³/yr)"，两处都算 units_in_header=false；正文六表无一在其表头印单位。[table.units_in_header]
旋转表格照实记，行数按年份占位计：p24 与 p27 两张表都是横排打印，orientation=landscape；p24 的 2016-2023 每个年份占两行数值而 2024-2030 只剩两列有值，故 rows 按 15 个年份记并在备注写明 23 行数值的实际排布。[table.orientation]
未检出区域的表不入账但必须写明：p25 "MODEL 1 - Climate Change not factored in" 与 p26 "MODEL 2 - Climate Change included" 两张 21 行的宽表只用文字排版、没有任何矢量线，检测器没有给出区域，因此不进行台账，只在论文备注里记明，避免把它们算进 unaccounted。[table.header_rows]
引用按纸面：三张附录图各被正文点过一次（4.1 于 p13、4.2 于 p13、4.3 于 p14），都是括号内的 Appendix Figure 写法；p10 的尼罗河折线图与 p12 的流量图只有一处指示性指代（p11 "ing chart shows data for 2005"），其余图与全部表靠"following/the above"这类泛指落位。[mention.style]
